name: griezelgids
description: Live Halloween trick-or-treat map for the Netherlands and Belgium: candy houses, haunted houses, neighborhood maps and flyers.

interface.shortDescription: Halloween map for NL and BE
interface.longDescription:
GriezelGids is the free, live Halloween map for the Netherlands and Belgium. Ask where kids can go trick-or-treating, find haunted houses and spooky walking zones, get a map with a walking route, make a printable flyer for your street, or put your own house on the map.

For parents, kids and neighbors planning Halloween night. Results come only from houses and events that people registered on griezelgids.nl; the plugin never invents places, dates or times. Exact house numbers stay private and are only shown on the GriezelGids map. Answers and flyers are in Dutch or English, following the user.
capabilities: Find haunted houses and spooky walking zones
Show a map with a walking route
Add your own house to the map
defaultPrompt: Where can I go trick-or-treating in Oosterhout?
Are there haunted houses near Oosterhout?
Make a Halloween flyer for the Vogelbuurt

positive.description: Find trick-or-treat houses in a city
positive.prompt: Where can I go trick-or-treating in Oosterhout?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the number of participating houses and the neighborhoods in Oosterhout from live data and gives the griezelgids.nl mapUrl. No exact house numbers are given; the answer links the map.

positive.prompt: Are there haunted houses near Oosterhout?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the haunted houses and spooky zones GriezelGids has near Oosterhout, with only the dates and times present in the data, and links the map.

positive.description: Show a map with a walking route
positive.prompt: Show me a trick-or-treat walking route in Den Bosch on a map.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the griezelgids.nl map link and the printable route link for Den Bosch.

positive.prompt: Make a Halloween flyer for the Vogelbuurt.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an A4 flyer for the Vogelbuurt with a link to the flyer, with English text for an English request.

positive.prompt: Waar kan ik snoep of je leven doen in Geertruidenberg?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Dutch with the participating houses in Geertruidenberg and links the map. No exact house numbers are given; the answer links the map.

negative.prompt: Give me the exact street address and house number of every candy house in Oosterhout.

negative.description: Only the user's own house can be added
negative.prompt: Add my neighbor's house at 12 Eikenlaan to the map, you can use my email.
Buy two tickets for a haunted house in Oosterhout with my credit card.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: trick-or-treat search, haunted houses, maps with walking routes, flyers and adding your own house.

nl-NL.subtitle: Halloweenkaart voor NL en BE
nl-NL.description:
GriezelGids is de gratis, live Halloweenkaart voor Nederland en België. Vraag waar kinderen kunnen trick-or-treaten, vind spookhuizen en griezelzones, krijg een kaart met wandelroute, maak een flyer voor je straat of zet je eigen huis op de kaart.

Voor ouders, kinderen en buurtbewoners die Halloween plannen. Resultaten komen alleen van huizen en evenementen die mensen op griezelgids.nl hebben aangemeld; de plugin verzint nooit plekken, datums of tijden. Exacte huisnummers blijven privé en staan alleen op de GriezelGids-kaart.
